outcome: Evaluate and implement Datadog Pro Observability for application tracing, infrastructure health and cross-stack observability, under a measured pilot and governed approval process.
overview: Datadog Pro Observability addresses source evidence is scattered across documents and transaction systems, leading to repeated checks and incomplete case files in cross-industry operations. The first proof of value uses application spans, infrastructure metrics and log events. It produces a reviewed operational recommendation and a traceable decision record. The commercial success measure is mean time to detect and resolve production incidents, established from customer baseline data before any improvement is claimed.
kpi: mean time to detect and resolve production incidents

scope:
Delivery model: Redington or approved implementation partner, eligibility and staffing pending confirmation.
Duration: Discovery and design first; pilot and rollout durations depend on data access and scope; no fixed commitment.
1) Discover source quality and baseline: application spans, infrastructure metrics and log events; define mean time to detect and resolve production incidents and data-processing boundary.
2) Design control points, security and connector contracts; obtain owner approval from IT and platform operations director.
3) Implement one bounded workflow, instrument missing-data exceptions and system-of-record write-back.
4) Test positive, negative, privilege, partial-data and rollback cases including run golden documents and exceptions against the system of record.
5) Review KPI in the pilot, document evidence, perform training and agree transition.
deliverables: Agreed test threshold for mean time to detect and resolve production incidents
